transcript: Most of the creators have their own skill, their own audience, and their own content, but unhe use monetize karna nahi aata. Lekin yeh problem utni badi bhi nahi hai agar tumhare paas ek sahi system hai. Isiliye maine ek tool dhoondha hai jo tumhare content ko monetize karne ka poora system tumhe dega. Is tool se tum apne knowledge ko package kar sakte ho in form of guides, courses ya fir koi digital product. Aur use tum seedha is platform pe publish kar sakte ho. Jab tumhe koi DM kare ya fir comment kare, tum apna product easily un tak distribute kar sakte ho with using its own AutoDM feature. And you know what is the best part about it? Yeh AI se har ek automated action ko as a human mimic karta hai. So Instagram tumhara account kabhi flag bhi nahi karega. Is tool se you can build your own paid community and earn around $500 to $600 as a passive income being a content creator. So agar tumhe is tool ke baare mein detail mein jaanna hai, just comment me, and I'll send it directly to you.
